plain_takeaway: Oct-Dec freezing degree-days changed by about +15 C-days per decade (95% CI -108 to +111). Not statistically distinguishable from no change in this 24-winter record; that is not proof of no change.
Mid-winter thaw days are almost always zero at this location in 2001-2024 (daily mean above 0 C on at most 1 day in 24 winters), so no trend can be estimated.
